$comment: Save-worthy #1: the four GTM decisions from the Spec lead magnet (Notion 3e255c40-e4e7-81bd-9c00-da722e2dacca), as the literal typed questions. Options copied verbatim from the Spec payloads. Bands = TypeSafe's worked example (docs mirror lines 1269-1286), captioned as such.
title: Four GTM decisions, *typed.*
sub: The exact Jev questions behind lead routing. The first three share one call. The reply check runs on its own.

decisions.name: Worth paying to enrich?
decisions.ask: Revenue-function title, inside your size band, at least one intent signal.
decisions.route: Leans yes: spend the credit. Nothing to route on: a wrong call costs one fee.

decisions.name: Which tier?
decisions.ask: Place it only when title and company say enough. Never force an unclear lead.
decisions.route: UNRESOLVED goes to a human, not into a low score.

decisions.name: Which sequence?
decisions.ask: Given the lead and its tier, which sequence does it enter?
decisions.route: do_not_send holds every UNRESOLVED lead for review.

decisions.name: What kind of reply?
decisions.ask: Sarcastic, ambiguous, mixed or off-pipeline replies are needs_human.
decisions.route: Separate call. Batch a whole inbox pull into it.

bands.caption: TypeSafe's worked example, not a rule: under 0.5 to a human, destructive actions above 0.9. Re-derive per question.

never: NEVER SEND JEV: arithmetic · date comparisons · anything that must write prose.
